assets.title: contract
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One square transparent PNG editorial illustration for a baseball transfer news video on a dark navy background. Subject: two generic hands shaking to symbolize an agreed contract, with simple plain sleeves, no people or faces. Flat calm cut-paper shapes, muted teal, warm ivory, soft ochre, charcoal outlines, minimal hard-edged shading. Centered compact silhouette, generous transparent margin on all sides. Opaque solid interior; only thin antialiasing at edges. No glow, blur, shadow outside silhouette, texture, haze, fringe, gradient or photography. No text, letters, digits, logos, watermark, real people, stadiums, team identifiers or uniform numbers. Exactly one scene. Save the output for local project use.
